description: Election Commission - Notify the appointment of R. M. A. Padmal Perera, elected as the member of the Dehiwala-Mount Laviniya Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a newly elected member to replace a deceased council member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for government bodies.
